_about: Hand-written plain noun phrases for every coverage test (instructions/rulings_12.md section 7e). Keyed by rule id and test index; source_hint is the start of the test's source text, used to detect a renumbered or changed test. Phrases for exemption tests complete 'the property is <phrase>'; coverage tests describe what the rule covers ('the rule covers <phrase>'); timing tests complete 'once <phrase>'. The engine refuses to run if a test has no phrase.
